customer_message.subject: chat – landlord threatening to end lease
customer_message.body:
Arjun Ndlovu: hello, I'm renting a 5.5-room flat at Eichholzweg 104 in Wädenswil, managed by Verwaltung Lindenhof Treuhand
Arjun Ndlovu: I'm behind with three months, CHF 4950, the self-employed thing didn't work out
Arjun Ndlovu: the manager told me at the door this morning that if the money isn't there by the end of the month "we're done and you'll get the termination"
Arjun Ndlovu: to be clear I haven't received any termination letter or anything written so far
Arjun Ndlovu: can they just kick me out like that? what should I do now?
